rationale: All 6 prior blocking findings verified resolved against current source: CreateUserPopup.tsx now resets the form (including role switches) via useEffect(reset(defaultValues)) on close (CR-002); gates submission with formState.isSubmitting passed as submitDisabled (CR-003); disables the Auditor switch when Admin or Maintainer is on and the Admin switch when Maintainer is on, completing the mirrored interdependency rule (CR-004, CR-005); UsersManagementPage.createUserButton.test.tsx now covers the auditor-hidden and admin+local cases (CR-001); and user.ts's createUser catch now toasts error?.parsedError?.message with the fixed string only as fallback (CR-006). 0 unresolved, 0 superseded, 0 unaccounted.

business_review.item: Create user button appears in UsersManagementPage top bar, in the existing role-gated control slot
business_review.notes: Added inside the existing top-bar controls div alongside UsersManagementBulkActions — UsersManagementPage.tsx:379-391

business_review.item: Button visible only when isAdmin || isMaintainer; never visible to auditors
Button hidden entirely (not disabled) when IDP provider is not 'local'
business_review.notes: canCreateUser gates on appInfoStore.getIdpProvider()==='local'; rendered via {canCreateUser && <Button/>} — UsersManagementPage.tsx:82,388-390

business_review.item: Clicking the button opens a Popup-based modal with email, username, password, name, and three Switch role toggles
business_review.notes: CreateUserPopup.tsx wraps Popup with Controller-bound email/username/password/name Inputs and is_auditor/is_admin/is_maintainer Switches

business_review.item: Password input uses type="password"; no visibility toggle and no confirm-password field
business_review.notes: CreateUserPopup.tsx:131 sets type="password"; no toggle or confirm field present

business_review.item: Enabling is_maintainer forces is_admin on; enabling is_admin or is_maintainer clears is_auditor
business_review.notes: Verified for the enable direction only (CreateUserPopup.tsx:176-205). The reverse guards (disable Admin while Maintainer on; enable Auditor while Admin/Maintainer on) are missing — CR-004, CR-005

business_review.item: Form validation (Yup): email format/presence, username 3-50 chars, password required, name optional
Submitting a valid form calls a new userStore.createUser performing POST /v1/admin/users with a UserCreatePayload body
business_review.notes: CreateUserPopup.tsx:75 calls userStore.createUser(data); user.ts:470-483 posts to 'v1/admin/users' with skipErrorHandling:true

business_review.item: On success: modal closes, a success toast is shown, and the users list refreshes without a manual reload
business_review.notes: user.ts:475 toasts info; onCreated() (CreateUserPopup.tsx:76) triggers UsersManagementPage.tsx:431-434 to close and refresh

business_review.item: On failure: an error toast surfaces the backend's message and the modal stays open with entered values intact
business_review.notes: catch always toasts hardcoded 'Failed to create user', never error?.parsedError?.message — user.ts:478-481. See CR-006

business_review.item: New tests cover button visibility (admin/maintainer/auditor/non-local combinations), role-switch interdependency, and success/failure submission
business_review.notes: createUserButton.test.tsx covers hidden-non-privileged, hidden-non-local-admin, visible-maintainer-local; missing auditor-hidden and admin-visible-local cases. See CR-001

business_review.item: Modal built on Popup (never PrimeReact Dialog directly), using RHF + @hookform/resolvers/yup + Controller, following ChangeRolePopup.tsx
business_review.notes: CreateUserPopup.tsx uses Popup, useForm/Controller/yupResolver mirroring ChangeRolePopup.tsx's shape

business_review.item: The page owns the modal's open/closed boolean state
business_review.notes: isCreateUserOpen state lives in UsersManagementPage.tsx:86, passed as isOpen/onClose/onCreated props

business_review.item: No changes to UserDetailsPopup.tsx or the existing edit-user flow (Non-goal)
business_review.notes: Diff does not touch UserDetailsPopup.tsx or updateUser

business_review.item: No new or changed feature-flag gating (useUserManagementEnabled()) (Non-goal)
business_review.notes: No feature-flag hook touched; only local-auth and role gating added

business_review.item: No changes to backend authorization or the POST /v1/admin/users contract itself (Non-goal)
business_review.notes: Frontend-only diff: UsersManagementPage.tsx, CreateUserPopup.tsx, user.ts, types/entity/user.ts, tests

standards_review.notes: All 3 commit subjects match the documented EPMCDME-XXXX: Capital sentence pattern.
No .ai-run/guides/standards/code-quality.md exists and no code_quality ArtifactRef was passed; no documented standard to adjudicate against.
No dangerouslySetInnerHTML/innerHTML sinks, no untrusted-input navigation, no postMessage listeners, no VITE_*/window._env_ exposure; catch blocks never log the payload (plaintext password).

findings.title: Missing auditor-hidden and admin+local test cases
findings.recommendation: Add two cases: auditor+local renders no button; admin (non-maintainer)+local renders and opens it.

findings.title: Form values not reset on popup close/reopen
findings.recommendation: Destructure reset from useForm and call it in a useEffect keyed on isOpen.

findings.title: No guard against duplicate submit while in flight
findings.recommendation: Read isSubmitting from useForm's formState and pass submitDisabled={isSubmitting} to Popup.

findings.title: Auditor switch not disabled when Admin/Maintainer is on
findings.recommendation: Disable the Auditor Switch when is_admin || is_maintainer is true.

findings.title: Admin switch not disabled when Maintainer is on
findings.recommendation: Disable the Admin Switch when is_maintainer is true.

findings.title: createUser error toast ignores backend message
findings.recommendation: Change the catch to toaster.error(error?.parsedError?.message || 'Failed to create user').

finding_status.notes: createUserButton.test.tsx now has 'is hidden for an auditor on a local IDP' and 'is visible for an admin on a local IDP and opens the popup' cases.
CreateUserPopup.tsx:83-87 adds useEffect(() => { if (!isOpen) reset(defaultValues) }, [isOpen, reset]); confirmed by CreateUserPopup.test.tsx's reset test.
CreateUserPopup.tsx:74 destructures isSubmitting from formState and CreateUserPopup.tsx:103 passes submitDisabled={isSubmitting} to Popup.
CreateUserPopup.tsx:182 sets disabled={isAdminValue || isMaintainerValue} on the Auditor Switch.
CreateUserPopup.tsx:195 sets disabled={isMaintainerValue} on the Admin Switch.
user.ts:480 now toasts error?.parsedError?.message || 'Failed to create user'; user.createUser.test.ts asserts the backend message surfaces.
